_note: Enter MEASURED values only. null = not yet measured. tools/budget.py uses these to override estimates and to evaluate PASS/FIX/STOP gates. Record units exactly as named.

owned_items._note: List BOM ids you already own/bought, e.g. ["E01", "X02"]. Owned rows are excluded from the remaining-spend total.

stage1._how: Print the E2 wing sample in the production LW-PLA profile; density = measured mass / slicer-reported extruded volume (cm3).

stage2._how: One motor + chosen prop + ESC + E01 battery on a GUARDED stand. Log each throttle step for >= 10 s after settling. voltage_v is LOADED voltage at the battery.

component_masses_g._note: Measured per-unit masses keyed by BOM id, e.g. {"P01": 33.4}. Overrides the BOM estimate.
